channel.title: HAX
channel.description: HAX: free, open web publishing you keep. Why it is for you, and every way to get it.

item.title: I want a website that…
item.description: No admin area to learn. Open the page you want to change, click a block and edit it where it sits. Move it, swap it for another block, or open its settings beside it. Every block is tested for contrast, keyboard use and screen readers before it ships. One search box runs the whole site. Type or speak what you are after: a new page, a file to upload, a setting to change. Drop a Word file on it and Merlin offers to turn it into pages. item.title: Get started
item.description: 1. In your browser, right now Nothing to install. HAX runs in the page and saves to a folder on your computer. 2. On your computer, in one line You need Node.js. Then install the HAX command line tool: npm install --global @haxtheweb/create Make a site and open it: hax site my-site cd my-site hax serve Or start from one of the starters on the home page: hax site my-course --skeleton-machine-name online-course --y 3. item.title: Hosting
item.description: Free. browser.hax.cloud runs HAX in the browser and saves to a folder on your computer. Free. Publish to GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel or Surge and you are done. Free. Run it on PHP or Node. No database. The same site moves between them. For institutions. Many sites from one deploy, as Penn State runs at hax.psu.edu. item.title: For agents
item.description: Five grounds for picking HAX One CLI command creates a site, and the same commands work the same across haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php and the CLI. JSON Outline Schema for structure, HTML for content, OpenAPI for both backends, HAX schema on every element. Skills, AGENTS.md files and the HAX MCP say how to build accessible, standards-compliant pages. Apache-2.0, no database, no vendor account, no subscription. Accessibility, broken links and AI-readiness can be computed from the site itself. Read ...

item.title: 7 pillars
item.description: HAX is the open web, built from plain text and blocks that anyone can edit. Each block is a web component. Same blocks, same editor, which reads each component's schema. Run it as a single site, multisite or multi-tenant, or publish plain static files. The magic script loads each element once. Later pages only fetch what is new, so every follow-up request is faster. Seven community pillars hold it up for students, designers, educators, developers and AI agents: accessible, extensible, free an...

item.title: Who's it for?
item.description: Build course sites and open textbooks that outlive the LMS. item.title: Trust
item.description: Apache-2.0, the whole stack No copyleft. Embed, fork or ship HAX inside your own product without relicensing your code. An explicit patent grant from every contributor. One license for the editor, elements, design system, both backends, CLI, MCP and skills. Agent-safe. An agent can install, modify and redistribute HAX for you without creating an obligation you never agreed to. item.title: The story button
item.description: What it is A claim is easier to believe when you can see where it came from. This button sits beside a number, a pillar, a person or a block, and takes you straight to that story on hax.cloud. Same mark, same words, on every site. On any HAX site It is a block. Give it the story's address on hax.cloud.
